package onboardingpathexecution

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
)

func TestBuildFrozenSnapshotIncludesWholeGraphWithoutLegacyProfile(t *testing.T) {
	graph := domain.GoalGraph{Goal: domain.LearningGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "g", Title: "Foundation"}, Targets: []domain.LearningTarget{
		{Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: "concept", Key: "a", Version: "v1"}, Title: "A", ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "M", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "S", LessonCode: "one", LessonTitle: "One"},
		{Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: "concept", Key: "b", Version: "v1"}, Title: "B", Prerequisites: []domain.TargetRef{{Type: "concept", Key: "a", Version: "v1"}}, ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "M", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "S", LessonCode: "two", LessonTitle: "Two", LessonOrder: 1},
	}}
	policy := domain.PolicyBundle{PlannerVersion: "p", PedagogyProfile: "p-v1", PresentationStyle: "s-v1", GenerationPolicy: "g-v1", PedagogyStrategies: []domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1, Config: []byte(`{}`)}}}
	snapshot := domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{Schema: domain.StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, Profile: domain.StudentReadinessProfile{KnownStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}, DesiredStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}, PreferredLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui"}, ContentLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui", Source: "preferred_language"}}}
	frozen, hash, err := BuildFrozenSnapshot(graph, policy, snapshot, pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if hash == "" || len(frozen.Course.Modules) != 1 || len(frozen.Course.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons) != 2 || frozen.Course.Language != "ru" {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe frozen result %#v", frozen.Course)
	}
	if frozen.Authoring.DirectionCode != "" || frozen.Authoring.SelfAssessedExperience != "" || frozen.Authoring.KnownStacks != nil || frozen.Authoring.DesiredStacks != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invented optional facts %#v", frozen.Authoring)
	}
}

func TestFrozenSnapshotRoundTripPreservesAnsweredEmptyStacks(t *testing.T) {
	graph := domain.GoalGraph{Goal: domain.LearningGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "g", Title: "Foundation"}, Targets: []domain.LearningTarget{{Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: "concept", Key: "a", Version: "v1"}, Title: "A", ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "M", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "S", LessonCode: "one", LessonTitle: "One"}}}
	policy := domain.PolicyBundle{PlannerVersion: "p", PedagogyProfile: "p-v1", PresentationStyle: "s-v1", GenerationPolicy: "g-v1", PedagogyStrategies: []domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1, Config: []byte(`{}`)}}}
	snapshot := domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{Schema: domain.StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, Profile: domain.StudentReadinessProfile{KnownStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{}, ValuesPresent: true}, DesiredStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}, PreferredLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui"}, ContentLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui", Source: "preferred_language"}}}
	frozen, _, err := BuildFrozenSnapshot(graph, policy, snapshot, pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(frozen)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err := DecodeFrozenSnapshot(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !decoded.Readiness.Profile.KnownStacks.ValuesPresent || decoded.Readiness.Profile.KnownStacks.Values == nil || len(decoded.Readiness.Profile.KnownStacks.Values) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("answered empty stacks were not replayable: %#v", decoded.Readiness.Profile.KnownStacks)
	}
}
